## Education

School of Public Policy *(in progress)*

## Research Interests

Innovation policy · patent law and economics · artificial intelligence · causal inference ·
computational social science

## Methods

Difference-in-differences and modern robustness methods (event studies, HonestDiD
sensitivity analysis, entropy balancing) · large-scale text analysis of patent claims ·
full-population patent data pipelines (PatentsView, EPO, Google Patents) ·
R, Python, Stata

## Research Experience

**Graduate Research Assistant**, School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Georgia
Institute of Technology — Spring–Summer 2023

Funded by the Georgia Department of Transportation. Identified strategies to rebalance
contractual terms for major design-build (DB) and Public-Private Partnership (P3) projects
to enhance competition in the transportation infrastructure market.
